params.q: Which coaching institute did Akshit Bhardwaj, UPSC CSE 2025 AIR 12, study at?

response.reconstructed_markdown:
Akshit Bhardwaj studied and took guidance from prominent coaching institutes during his UPSC preparation:

- [Vajiram & Ravi](https://vajiramandravi.com/upsc-exam/akshit-bhardwaj-upsc-air-12-2025/): He enrolled as a General Studies Foundation student and utilized their GS courses, Prelims CAMP, and Interview Guidance Programme. [0] [1]
- [Vision IAS](https://visionias.in/blog/toppers-strategy/akshit-bhardwaj-air-12-upsc-2025-background-upsc-journey-marksheet-toppers-copy): He was associated with their test series and programs, including the All India Prelims and Mains Test Series, Abhyaas Prelims, and the Personality Development / Interview Program. [2]
